content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: General FAQ ## slug: messaging-general-faq ## seoTitle: General FAQ ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End **Q: How do I cancel my Messaging plan in the app?** A: While users can perform upgrades from the Admin panel, there isn't a self-service option to cancel. Please contact {{variable.Link_BlackthornSupport}} to create a case, and they will help you cancel your subscription. **Q: How do I remove phone numbers from my subscription?** A: The first step to remove one or more phone numbers is to contact {{variable.Link_BlackthornSupport}}. We will then remove unwanted phone numbers from your Twilio and Salesforce accounts and update your subscription to reflect the correct number of phone numbers.
